title: fix(spec)!: the published searchFields declarations refuse a value naming no field, as the Data API doors do
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCNbr1niqMMAugbuJbWkmUX)_

Fixes #27683

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the published declarations of the search-field override (`QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields`, `QuerySchema.searchFields`, `FullTextSearchSchema.fields`, reached through `QueryWithTransportSchema` and `FindDataRequestSchema.query`) refuse a value naming no field, which they admitted before. The doors already refused it with a 400 (#27484 / PR #27670); nothing is widened and no key is added, removed or renamed.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — every place under `skills/**` that teaches the narrowed members still holds (`git grep -n "searchFields\|search\.fields" -- skills` at this head): `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` § Full-Text Search teaches a non-empty `searchFields` and "Omit it to search the object's declared `searchableFields`", its key tables (lines 25-26) list the engine option, which this PR does not narrow, and its eval and `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:125` emit only named overrides. No skill emits or recommends an empty override.

`Metadata-protocol: none` was measured, not assumed: no metadata type embeds `QuerySchema`, `FullTextSearchSchema` or the transport bag (`git grep` of every `*.zod.ts` under `packages/spec/src/{ui,automation,ai,system,kernel,security}` for the three schema names and for `searchFields`: only prose comments in `ui/component.zod.ts`). The readers are request bodies, the driver and API contracts, and codegen.

PR #27670 (#27484) merged at `86f2afeb` before this branch started, so there is no landing order to name; its predicate was measured on `main`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已发布的三处 `searchFields` 声明（`QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields`、`QuerySchema.searchFields`、`FullTextSearchSchema.fields`）不再接受“一个字段都没写”的值（空串、只有逗号和空格、空数组、对象形 `search.fields: []`），三处描述带同一句接受集说明；`POST /data/:object/query` 因此在请求体 schema 处拒收，回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`（原为门内的 `VALIDATION_ERROR`），与 `select: []` 一致。
- 为什么改：数据接口自 #27484 起已拒收这些值，但发布的 Zod 与 JSON Schema 仍声明接受，按 schema 生成的客户端和 AI 会写出被门拒收的请求；`select` 的同类声明早已收紧（#26909）。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄声明，接受集与门完全一致（有逐值对照测试）；`POST /query` 的错误码从 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 变 `VALIDATION_FAILED`，仍是 400、仍不读库。引擎侧声明不动（下一阶段卡）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/search-fields-names-a-field.ts`（接受集与两条臂），`packages/rest/src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts`（POST 行迁到 schema 拒收表、末尾 parity 用例），`packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts`（两处成员）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/search-fields-names-a-field.test.ts`，应见 39 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（进队前欠一次契约复核）。

## What changes

### Measured first, on `origin/main` `bfdaba43` (#27670 merged)

Each declaration parsed with the four spellings of "names no field", next to what the protocol door (`assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`, the gate `findData` calls for the standalone slot and for the object-form `search.fields`) answers for the same value. The door column is the registry-less host, so it is the shape rule alone; a registered object answers the same for these values, because the empty check runs before the field-map lookup.

| value | `$searchFields` | `QuerySchema.searchFields` | `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` | `FindDataRequestSchema` `query.$searchFields` / `query.searchFields` / `query.search.fields` | `EngineQueryOptionsSchema` / `EngineAggregateOptionsSchema` / `EngineCountOptionsSchema` `.searchFields` | protocol door (standalone / `search.fields`) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `''` | accept | string refused (array-only) | n/a | accept / string refused / n/a | n/a (array-only) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| `' , '` | accept | string refused | n/a | accept / string refused / n/a | n/a | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| `[]` | accept | accept | accept | accept / accept / accept | accept / accept / accept | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| `search: { fields: [] }` | (see `FullTextSearchSchema.fields`) | | accept | accept | accept (via the shared `FullTextSearchSchema`) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| `['']` (control) | accept | accept | accept | accept | accept | accepted as a value; refused as an unknown field once the object is known |
| `'name'` / `['name']` (control) | accept | accept (array) | accept | accept | accept | accepted |

The door's predicate, read at `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts` on `main`: a string is `split(',')`, trimmed and emptied of blank members; an array is kept as sent; the override is refused as naming no field iff that leaves zero names. That is the set used here, exactly.

### After, at this PR's head

| value | `$searchFields` | `QuerySchema.searchFields` | `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` | `FindDataRequestSchema` (all three slots) | engine-side declarations | protocol door |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `''`, `'   '`, `','`, `' , '` | **refused** (`invalid_format`, "Name at least one field, or leave the key out to search the default search fields") | string refused, as before | n/a | **refused** at `query.$searchFields` | unchanged | unchanged (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`) |
| `[]` | **refused** (`too_small`, same sentence) | **refused** | **refused** | **refused** at `query.searchFields` / `query.$searchFields` / `query.search.fields` | `searchFields` unchanged (still admits `[]`); `search.fields: []` refused through the shared `FullTextSearchSchema` | unchanged |
| `['']`, `'name'`, `' name , email '`, `['name']` | accept | accept | accept | accept | accept | unchanged |

### The declarations (`packages/spec/src/data/`)

- New `search-fields-names-a-field.ts`, outside the `data` barrel (the `projection-names-a-field.ts` pattern): the refusal sentence `SEARCH_FIELDS_NAMES_NO_FIELD`, the shared accept-set sentence `SEARCH_FIELDS_ACCEPT_SET` ("at least one field name; a value naming no field (blank, only commas and spaces, or an empty list) is refused"), the string arm (`regex(/[^\s,]/)`: holds iff some comma segment has a non-whitespace character, `\s` being the set `trim()` strips) and the array arm (`min(1)`). Its own module because `query.zod.ts` cannot import `data-engine.zod.ts`. Both are a pattern and a minimum rather than refinements, so the published JSON Schema states them (`pattern`, `minItems`), and `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` does not move.
- `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$searchFields` (`data-engine.zod.ts`): `z.union([searchFieldsString(), searchFieldsArray()])`, still `.nullable().optional()`, so an explicit `null` is still a withdrawal.
- `QuerySchema.searchFields` and `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` (`query.zod.ts`): `searchFieldsArray().optional()`.
- Each of the three `.describe()` texts ends with the shared accept-set sentence; the references (`content/docs/references/{api/contract,api/protocol,data/data-engine,data/query}.mdx`) were regenerated with `check:generated --fix`.
- A blank member (`['']`) is deliberately outside the set. Unlike the projection, whose door refuses a blank member through the same "names no field" envelope, the search-field door keeps it as a name and then refuses it as an unknown field when the object is known (`INVALID_FIELD`). Refusing it at the schema would make the schema refuse a value the door's "names no field" predicate admits, so the two would no longer refuse the same set.

### The stage boundary (what the engine card owns)

Measured item 2 of the order: neither `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.searchFields` (`data-engine.zod.ts` ~:189) nor the aggregate (~:513) and count (~:558) siblings is a declaration the door parses. `POST /data/:object/query` parses `FindDataRequestSchema` (whose `query` is `QueryWithTransportSchema`, built from `QuerySchema` and `QueryTransportParamsSchema`) at `packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts` and in the dispatcher (`packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts`); `GET /data/:object` and export reach `findData` with no schema at all. The three engine-side declarations are the in-process engine's options (`IDataEngine.find` / `aggregate` / `count`), so they stay, and so does the engine's tolerance of an empty override: the next stage, in the #27008 shape.

One coupling the engine card should know about: `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.search` (and its aggregate and count siblings) declare their structured form as the shared `FullTextSearchSchema`, so `search: { query, fields: [] }` is now refused by those engine-side declarations too. The engine does not parse `search` (`fillQueryAstDefaults` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` says so and why), so no runtime answer moves. Likewise `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.expand` values are `QuerySchema`, so an `expand` entry's `searchFields: []` is refused by the declaration; the engine does not parse `searchFields` on an expand entry either. The `stage boundary` describe in the new spec test pins the three `searchFields` members still admitting `[]`, so the engine card flips it on purpose.

### `POST /data/:object/query` (`packages/rest/src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts`)

Cleared by the seat's claim amendment on #27683 (the file was outside the dispatched surface). The two POST rows #27670 pinned at the door's `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` now answer at the body schema, `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, with `fields[0].field` naming the key: `query.searchFields`, `query.$searchFields` or `query.search.fields`. That is how the route already answers `select: []` (#26909). The new `REFUSED_POST_AT_SCHEMA` table covers `searchFields: []`, `$searchFields: ""`, `$searchFields: " , "`, `$searchFields: []` and `search: { query, fields: [] }`, each with "no read of the object". The GET list and export rows are unchanged: those doors have no body schema and still answer the door's `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields-names-a-field.test.ts` (39 cases): per declaration, each empty spelling refused with the sentence at the member's path (`$searchFields`: four strings and `[]`; `QuerySchema.searchFields` and `FullTextSearchSchema.fields`: `[]`), and controls kept unchanged (one name, a spaced comma list, a list, a blank member); the same refusals through `QueryWithTransportSchema` and `FindDataRequestSchema.query` for `$searchFields`, `searchFields`, `search.fields` and `$search.fields`; an explicit `null` still a withdrawal; a kept comma list lowered onto `searchFields`; each `.describe()` carrying the shared sentence; and the stage-boundary pin above.
- `packages/rest/src/data-empty-search-fields-door.test.ts`: the POST rows move to `REFUSED_POST_AT_SCHEMA` as above, and a new **parity** case holds the schema door (`FindDataRequestSchema`, which the POST route parses) and the protocol door (`protocol.findData`, which the GET and export routes reach with no schema) to one refused set, probe for probe, over a real SQLite object: 8 strings and 4 lists on `$searchFields`, the 4 lists on `searchFields` and on `search.fields` (20 probes). The schema refuses a probe iff the door answers `VALIDATION_ERROR` "names no field"; the verdict counts are pinned (8 refused, 9 served, 3 `INVALID_FIELD` for the blank member), so neither side can pass vacuously.

### Ablation

At head `7b3667ba` (fix and tests committed), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (trap restore), under the lock, against `src` (the spec suite imports the schemas by relative path, so no build or dist step is involved):

- Leg 1, array arm: `z.array(z.string()).min(1, SEARCH_FIELDS_NAMES_NO_FIELD)` → `z.array(z.string()).min(0, 'ABLATED-27683')`. Landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob `4cb5ab59` → `288d09ac`. `search-fields-names-a-field.test.ts`: 7 failed / 32 passed (every `[]` refusal on all three declarations and all four body spellings). Restored: blob `4cb5ab59` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg 2, string arm: `regex(/[^\s,]/, …)` → `regex(/ABLATED-27683|/, …)` (matches everything). Landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob `4cb5ab59` → `e13506da`. 4 failed / 35 passed: the four `$searchFields` string refusals on `QueryTransportParamsSchema`. The same strings through `QueryWithTransportSchema` stayed refused, because the fold lowers `''` / `' , '` to `searchFields: []` and the array arm on `QuerySchema.searchFields` catches it: the two arms back each other on the transport-aware slot. Restored: blob = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- A first leg-1 attempt used a replacement (`z.array(z.string())`) that already occurred inside the anchor, so the tool refused it (replacement count did not rise) and restored before running anything; it was redone with the marker above.
- Not ablated at the rest layer (it reads the spec through `dist`, so each leg would need a rebuild). What stands in for it: the first run of the new POST case on the narrowed spec was red on one row for the right reason (the structured form answered `query.search.fields`, not the `query.search` first written), so the case reads the live schema answer; and the parity case compares each of its 20 probes against the door's own answer with pinned verdict counts.

## Acceptance notes

- Two pre-existing schema/door differences outside "names no field", unchanged and not widened here: the door accepts a comma STRING in the canonical `searchFields` slot and in the structured `search.fields` ("the engine accepts the comma-string and array forms from either slot"), while `QuerySchema.searchFields` and `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` declare arrays only, so `POST {"searchFields":"label"}` is refused at the body schema as it was on `main` (measured: `query.searchFields` `invalid_type`). Recorded for the engine card's reading; not a finding filed from here.
- The `#27484` changeset's "Not yet narrowed" bullet becomes false in the same release; `check-empty-changeset` refuses an edit to a changeset the merge base carries, so this PR's changeset carries a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph instead.
- No caller in the repository sends an empty override through these schemas: the Console and the bundled view plugins send `$searchFields` only when it holds a field (#27484's measurement), and `git grep` for `searchFields: []` / `fields: []` beside `search` in `*.test.ts` finds only the rest door file (updated) and objectql's `query-expression-conformance.test.ts`, which calls `protocol.findData` directly and so is unaffected.
